---
title: code-block-bg metadata beats the palette canvas
format:
  html:
    theme: cosmo
highlight-style: github
code-block-bg: "#101112"
code-block-color: "#e0e1e2"
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
      ensureCssRegexMatches:
        # The document metadata wins over github-light's translated
        # `$code-block-bg: #ffffff !default` (the one-line escape
        # hatch under the palette-wins policy), and the palette's
        # token colors still apply.
        - ["#101112", "#e0e1e2", "\\.hl-keyword", "#d73a49"]
---

Overriding the palette-derived code-block canvas takes one YAML line
each for `code-block-bg` and `code-block-color`, matching Quarto 1's
metadata keys.

```python
def hello():
    print("Hello, World!")
```
